run_squad_training: run SQuAD question-answering fine-tuning on BERT, XLNet, XLM, or RoBERTa models with distributed training support
evaluate_squad_model: evaluate a fine-tuned question-answering model on SQuAD dev or test set and compute exact match and F1 scores
evaluate_hotpotqa_model: evaluate a fine-tuned question-answering model on HotpotQA dataset with answer and supporting fact metrics
load_and_cache_features: load and cache SQuAD dataset features as PyTorch tensors with configurable sequence length and document stride
run_squad_preprocess: preprocess SQuAD JSON dataset into cached tokenized features for efficient training and evaluation
